scope: Complete visible native image, not adjacent page prose; exposed DEV source annotation before new C candidate outputs
review: Single annotator, two visual passes: frozen native crop and independently rendered complete PDF page. Not independent human adjudication.

acceptance.minor_glyph_spacing_punctuation_errors: retain existing tolerance; no new exact-character gate
acceptance.material_failure: missing substantial visible blocks, changed required UI action/relationship, omitted timeline axis or changed clearly connected chronology
acceptance.source_uncertainty: explicitly marked uncertain small logo text/ambiguous branch joins; do not guess or borrow external release dates
acceptance.OCR: Score all readable literal blocks; keyword presence alone cannot pass full-image OCR
acceptance.description: Evaluate source meaning separately from OCR; generated text never replaces original source captions

meaning_obligations: This is a screenshot of the eCPA personnel-service portal application-system page.
Breadcrumb follows 首頁 → 我的專區 → 應用系統.
The left 應用系統 control is highlighted by a red rectangle.
The right B.人事資料服務 group is expanded and outlined in red.
B5A:個人簡要自述 is checked in the right list; it is also present as a highlighted main-area shortcut.
The depicted navigation/action involves 應用系統, B.人事資料服務 and B5A:個人簡要自述; do not substitute a neighboring B5/B6 service.
The main instruction distinguishes selecting usual applications from directly using the 連結 link.
The bottom note states that applications unavailable for linking require natural-person certificate login.
The page includes user/navigation, a poll and counters; these are part of full-image OCR scope, not grounds to infer live user identity or current website state.
source_uncertainties: The small @/account typography is low resolution; equivalent punctuation is not a material failure.

images.caption_context_only: Fig. 1. A timeline of existing large language models (having a size larger than 10B) in recent years. We mark the open-source LLMs in yellow color.
meaning_obligations: Identify a chronological model timeline spanning 2019 through 2023, with an arrow continuing beyond the right edge.
Preserve every year and every visible within-year period in axis order; repeated month labels belong to their corresponding years.
Model names, organization logos and branch connectors are distinct visual elements; this is not a numerical performance chart.
Retain all 45 readable model labels in full-image OCR, including Greek α/Σ and the distinction T0/mT0/T5/mT5.
Yellow label backgrounds denote Open-Source according to the figure legend; preserve the 19 highlighted model associations.
Retain the explicitly connected model/year/period associations listed above without inventing exact release dates.
The timeline leads through ChatGPT near late 2022 to GPT-4 near early 2023; they are distinct labels and positions.
Floating labels and dense multi-name blocks do not justify assigning each model an exact month without a visible unambiguous connector.
The adjacent source caption provides the >10B context; it must not be falsely reported as OCR text inside the crop.
Reconstruct what this source depicts, even where external historical release-date knowledge would disagree.
source_uncertainties: Small subtitle text under some organization logos is not fully legible; do not fabricate those glyphs.
Several floating model labels lack individual connector endpoints. All readable labels remain in scope, but exact release-month claims for those labels are unscorable from this image.
